connections.description: Providers that speak the OpenAI protocol. Keys are only written, never shown.
connections.empty: No connection set up yet. Without a connection nobody has AI.
connections.secretNote: A key you enter is stored encrypted and never shown again.
connections.kindHint: Cannot be changed later. “Local” may use http and internal addresses.
connections.baseUrlHint: For example https://api.openai.com/v1. Empty: the kind's address.
connections.secretStored: A key is stored. It is not shown.
connections.secretEnvHint: Name of a server environment variable with the prefix HERD_AI_.
connections.modelsHint: One model per line; the first is the standard model. Empty: the kind's models.
connections.dataLocationHint: Decides, with a space's AI policy, whether content may go here.
connections.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted. This fails while an assignment or an agent still uses it.

check.payment_required: The provider refuses: payment or credit needed (402).
check.forbidden: The provider refuses: no access to this model (403).
check.not_found: Model or address not found at the provider (404).
check.rate_limited: The provider refuses: rate limit reached (429).
check.redirect: The provider redirects; redirects are blocked.
check.invalid_response: The provider's answer could not be read.
check.secret_unavailable: Key unavailable (environment variable or server key missing).

assignments.description: Who uses which model: the person before their group before the standard. No assignment, no AI.
assignments.defaultHint: Applies to everyone without an own or group assignment. Empty: only those assigned have AI.
assignments.groupsHint: Someone in several groups gets the first group's assignment.
assignments.usersHint: A model of their own or explicitly no AI; this comes before group and standard.

usage.description: Usage per day (UTC). Costs only where a price is stored.

policy.title: AI policy
policy.hint: What AI connections may receive from this space.

explain.any: Content may go to any connection set up.
explain.restricted: Content goes only to connections at one of the chosen locations; otherwise the run stops.
explain.none: AI does not see this space: no hits, no reading.

policy.locationsRequired: Please choose at least one data location.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: AI staff that people with AI talk to in a direct message. In M5 agents only read.
agents.noConnection: Set up an AI connection first: an agent needs a model.
agents.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted. An agent that has talked is kept: pause it instead.

fields.name: Name
fields.introHint: Everyone with AI sees it in the profile and the direct message.
fields.instructionsHint: {{count}} of {{max}} characters. Only administrators see them.
fields.modelRequired: Please choose a connection and a model.
fields.responsibleHint: If deactivated, the agent does not answer.

stop.title: No answer:
stop.max_steps: The agent reached its maximum number of steps.
stop.deadline: The time for this run ran out.
stop.no_progress: The agent made no progress (it repeated the same request).
stop.rights_revoked: Rights changed or the agent was paused; the run was ended.
stop.policy_blocked: Stopped by a space's AI policy: what was read may not go to this connection.
stop.provider_refused: The provider refuses (access, credit or rate limit).
stop.error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

noRun.ai_unavailable: You have no AI assignment (any more); the agent does not answer.
noRun.agent_draft: This agent is a draft and does not answer.
noRun.agent_paused: This agent is paused and does not answer now. Your message is saved.
noRun.agent_responsible_inactive: The agent's responsible person is deactivated; it does not answer.
noRun.agent_connection_unavailable: No connection available: the agent's AI connection is disabled or no longer offers the model.
noRun.run_thread_reply: The agent does not answer thread replies; write in the conversation.
noRun.unknown: The agent does not answer this message.

header.paused: This agent is paused and does not answer now.

dm.title: Talk to an agent
dm.hint: A conversation between you and the agent alone.

sources.title: Read:
sources.hidden_one: {{count}} source is not visible to you.
sources.hidden_other: {{count}} sources are not visible to you.

ai.connection_name_taken: A connection with this name already exists.
ai.connection_in_use: The connection is still assigned or used by an agent.
ai.base_url_not_allowed: This address is not allowed (https only; internal addresses only for “Local”).
ai.model_unknown: This connection does not offer the model.
ai.group_twice: A group is in the list twice.
ai.usage_period_invalid: The period is invalid (at most 365 days).
ai.provider_failed: The provider did not return the model list.

agent.not_found: This agent does not exist (any more).
agent.in_use: This agent has already talked and is kept. Pause it instead.
agent.responsible_invalid: The responsible person must be active and not a guest.

secrets.key_missing: The server has no key (HERD_SECRET_KEY): only environment variables are possible.
secrets.env_name_invalid: Only environment variables with the prefix HERD_AI_ are allowed.

dm.agent_pair_only: One talks to an agent only as a pair.
